vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: food
Version: 1.0.1

The skill bundle defines a food tracking system that processes user input, extracts food-related information, and stores it in a local markdown file (`~/food/memory.md`). All instructions to the AI agent in `SKILL.md` and `processing.md` are aligned with the stated purpose of absorbing, analyzing, and organizing food data. There is no evidence of malicious intent, unauthorized data access, exfiltration, command execution, or prompt injection attempts designed to subvert the agent's core functions or compromise the system.

llm.summary: This food-tracking skill is a plain Markdown workflow that stores user-submitted food data locally and discloses that persistence, with privacy considerations users should understand before use.

dimensions.detail: Local storage at ~/food/memory.md is proportionate for a food tracker, but the stored data may reveal health, lifestyle, religious, or behavioral patterns.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected artifact contains Markdown instructions only, with no executable scripts, dependency installation, remote payload retrieval, or tool modification.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The phrase 'ANY food input' is broad, but the surrounding instructions limit handling to food-related photos, labels, menus, recipes, and text; ambiguous inputs should still be treated carefully.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill clearly discloses permanent/local persistence for user food data and restrictions, but it does not define retention limits or built-in review/delete controls.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The capability matches the stated purpose: classifying food inputs, logging meals/products/recipes/preferences, and generating food-pattern insights.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only if you want a local food history and preference database. Review ~/food/memory.md periodically and delete entries you do not want retained, especially allergies, restrictions, eating patterns, restaurants, and recipes tied to personal routines.
llm.findings:
[P2] expected: The flagged HTML comments are visible template comments showing the memory file format, not hidden operational instructions or prompt-injection directives.
[SQP-1] expected: Auto-classifying submitted food inputs is central to the skill's purpose; the broad wording creates ambiguity risk but does not show unrelated collection or hidden behavior.
[SQP-2] expected: Persistent storage of preferences, products, places, recipes, and patterns is disclosed and purpose-aligned, though users should be aware this can include sensitive dietary information.
